openai.label: OpenAI-compatible (Chat Completions)

anthropic.label: Anthropic-compatible (Messages)
anthropic.hint: Anthropic and compatible gateways: POST {base URL}/v1/messages

endpoint.keyHint: Stored in your system keychain, not in a file.
endpoint.modelIdPlaceholderPick: Pick one below, or type an id
endpoint.modelIdPlaceholder: The provider's model name, e.g. gpt-5 or mimo-v2.6-flash
endpoint.listing: Asking the endpoint for its models…
endpoint.listFailed: Couldn't list its models: {{error}}. Type the model id from the provider's docs.
endpoint.name: Name in Peko (optional)
endpoint.noKey: No key needed (a local server, for example)

inputs.hint: Turn on what your provider says the model takes. Attached files of these kinds go to the model itself.

price.hint: From your provider's pricing page. With a price, pekos' spend on this model counts toward their budgets. Leave the cache prices empty to count cached input at the input price.

add.title: Add a model
add.intro: Use the base URL, API format, and model name from your provider's docs. Providers that say "OpenAI-compatible" use Chat Completions.
add.conflict: A model named <name/> already exists — set another name under Advanced.

card.noKey: No key — add one under Edit

edit.title: Edit Model
